title: Early Task, Banked Time: Fixing a Kids App Reward Reset | vitalii.no
description:
My kid did the early break task with 25 minutes of TV time still on the clock, and the reward reset the counter to a flat 120 minutes -- throwing away the time she hadn't used yet. Doing the work early was supposed to pay off, not erase a window she was still sitting on.

I changed the gate logic in [workers/youtube-gate/index.js] from a hard reset (baseline = viewtime) to additive banking (baseline += limit), and removed an inner clamp in the countdown helper so a banked remainder actually reaches the kiosk badge, the on-TV overlay and the admin panel. I also reworded the kids-app card copy so it promises exactly what the gate now does: time is added, not restarted.

Finishing the reserve task with time still on the clock now banks that remainder instead of losing it -- 25 minutes left plus a done early task equals 85 minutes, not a reset to 60.
